basic_details.short_information: The Income Tax Department, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh Region, Bhopal has released the Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026 notification for Group C posts. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Income Tax Department, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh Region has released a total of 07 vacancies for the Canteen Attendant post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name in Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Canteen Attendant under the non-statutory Departmental Canteen of Income Tax Department, MP & CG Region.

faq.question: Q3. When will the online application process start for Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process will start from 11 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 31 August 2026 up to 23:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Income Tax MPCG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive salary under Pay Level-1 of 7th Pay Commission, Rs. 18,000 - 56,900.
